subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Her life became more organized.”?
options: She stopped buying drinks after school and brought water from home.
It rang between classes, before lunch, after lunch, and at the end of the day.
One day, the app stopped working after an update.
After a few days, it stopped coming.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「She stopped buying drinks after school and brought water from home.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

本文可直接核對「Her life became more organized. One day, the app stopped working after an update.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Her life became more organized. One day, the app stopped working after an update.」，答案為「One day, the app stopped working after an update.」。
